# Motionary 10.1.0

> Motionary is a zero-dependency motion library: scroll animations, 200+ presets and 191 animated Web Components (<usa-*>) that work in plain HTML and every framework, plus motionary/runtime — its own tween/timeline engine and format loaders.

Install: `npm i motionary` · CDN: https://unpkg.com/motionary@10/dist/components.umd.js (+ https://unpkg.com/motionary@10/dist/widgets.umd.js for 6.x+ widgets) · Manifest: https://harrisoncn.github.io/Motionary/components.json · Full text: https://harrisoncn.github.io/Motionary/llms-full.txt

Rules for using a component: (1) import its define function from `import.path` and call it once (or load the CDN bundle); (2) if `requires` is non-empty, install / import / register the prerequisites first (see the component's Prerequisites); (3) then use the tag in HTML.

## Runtime modules

- [motionary/runtime](https://github.com/HarrisonCN/Motionary/blob/main/docs/runtime/core.md): Shared ticker (one rAF loop), tween + timeline engine with easing, module registry with clear errors.
- [motionary/runtime/format-css](https://github.com/HarrisonCN/Motionary/blob/main/docs/runtime/format-css.md): Import CSS @keyframes text or live CSSKeyframesRule objects and Web Animations API keyframes (array or property-indexed) into a runtime timeline.
- [motionary/runtime/format-motion](https://github.com/HarrisonCN/Motionary/blob/main/docs/runtime/format-motion.md): Play Motion / Framer-style { initial, animate, transition } JSON (arrays as keyframes, times, repeatType, springs) with the runtime.

## Components

- `<usa-accordion>` (motionary/components/transitions): Smooth expand / collapse for native <details> — semantics, keyboard and find-in-page kept; no wrapper elements.
- `<usa-acrylic>` (motionary/components/background): Windows Fluent materials: frosted acrylic (backdrop blur + tint + noise) and mica. Solid fallback when transparency is reduced.
- `<usa-add-to-cart>` (motionary/components/widgets): 7.3: a buy button — the product photo flies on an arc into the cart, the cart badge bumps and the button morphs into a ✓ “Added” state. Works with <usa-cart-dra
- `<usa-ambient>` (motionary/components/page): A fixed page-wide layer: drifting particles, falling snow, twinkling stars, film grain or a gradient that shifts with scroll.
- `<usa-anim-icon>` (motionary/components/svg): Stroke icons that move: the bell rings, the heart beats, the check draws, the gear turns. Hover, click, in view or loop; decorative unless labelled.
- `<usa-audio>` (motionary/components/effects): 5.6: <usa-audio> renders a toggle (a user gesture starts Web Audio), detects beats and plays any registered effect on children with data-usa-beat="effect". JS: 
- `<usa-aurora>` (motionary/components/background): A slow drifting gradient mesh behind its content. Transforms only, paused off-screen, still under reduced motion.
- `<usa-auto-animate>` (motionary/components/layout): Wrap a list or grid: items that are added fade in, removed ones fade out in place, and everything else glides to its new spot — on sort, filter or resize. Zero 
- `<usa-auto-skeleton>` (motionary/components/page): Set loading and every heading, paragraph, image and button inside becomes a shimmering placeholder of its own size — no extra markup.
- `<usa-avatar-stack>` (motionary/components/ui): Overlapping avatars that spread apart with a spring on hover; extras collapse into “+N”.
- `<usa-back-to-top>` (motionary/components/page): Appears after you scroll, shows reading progress as a ring and springs the page back up, then moves focus to the top.
- `<usa-badge>` (motionary/components/ui): Count or dot badge that bumps with a spring when its value changes; 99+ capping, optional pulse.
- `<usa-badge-wall>` (motionary/components/widgets): 7.5: an achievement grid — locked badges are grey with a 🔒; unlock(name) flips a badge to its colour side with a shine and the “n / m unlocked” counter updates
- `<usa-bar-chart>` (motionary/components/widgets): 7.2: bars grow from the baseline in a stagger on first view and new data glides every bar to its new height — bars that appear grow in, bars that leave shrink a
- `<usa-bg-generator>` (motionary/components/widgets): 9.3: a background generator — pick a palette and a style (mesh gradient, grain, stripes, dots), shuffle the seed and copy the CSS.
- `<usa-blobs>` (motionary/components/background): Soft colour blobs that slowly morph and drift — a fluid gradient backdrop.
- `<usa-bottom-sheet>` (motionary/components/ui): A draggable sheet with snap points, inertia and drag-down-to-dismiss — the iOS / Android pattern for web and Windows web-view apps.
- `<usa-button>` (motionary/components/click): Spring-driven button click deformation: squash & stretch, elastic border-radius wobble, gooey liquid droplets, and a dent toward the pressed point. Combine them
- `<usa-card>` (motionary/components/cards): Ten card effects you can combine (effect="lift sheen"): flip (hover or click, x/y axis), holo, glass, border-glow, conic-border, lift, spotlight, sheen, paralla
- `<usa-card-stack>` (motionary/components/cards): A deck where the top card swipes away left or right (pointer, touch, arrow keys) and the next springs forward. loop sends cards to the back.
- `<usa-carousel>` (motionary/components/widgets): 6.2: swipe, drag, arrow keys, dots and autoplay (pauses on hover, focus, off screen). Four transitions — slide, fade, scale and a 3D "cards" coverflow. Reduced 
- `<usa-carousel-3d>` (motionary/components/cards): Items on a 3D ring, rotated by drag, arrow keys, clicks or autoplay — with spring motion. Reduced motion shows one flat item at a time.
- `<usa-cart-drawer>` (motionary/components/widgets): 7.3: a cart button with a count badge and a drawer that slides in from the side — lines slide in (or bump their quantity), removed lines collapse, the badge bum
- `<usa-chapter-nav>` (motionary/components/widgets): 9.1: chapter navigation for long-form stories — one entry per chapter with a reading-progress bar that fills as you scroll, the current chapter highlighted, cli
- `<usa-chat-composer>` (motionary/components/widgets): 7.8: an AI chat input that grows with its text; Enter sends, the send button pops when there is text and morphs into Stop while busy, with a thinking glow runni
- `<usa-check>` (motionary/components/feedback): The circle draws itself, then a check, cross or exclamation strokes in with a pop. Great after a payment or upload.
- `<usa-checkbox>` (motionary/components/click): Form-associated checkbox: the box springs and the check draws itself; indeterminate state, circle shape.
- `<usa-click>` (motionary/components/click): Wrap anything: ripple, burst (circle, star, heart, emoji), confetti, squish, press-spring and error shake — combinable, keyboard-friendly, optional haptics.
- `<usa-clock-control>` (motionary/components/widgets): 8.0: a pause / speed bar for the unified motion clock — pause, slow down or speed up every Motionary animation and frame loop on the page at once (motionClock i

- `<usa-color-picker>` (motionary/components/widgets): 6.9: a saturation / brightness square and a hue strip with spring-follow thumbs (both keyboard sliders), a preview chip that morphs to the new colour and swatch
- `<usa-command-palette>` (motionary/components/widgets): 7.9: a ⌘K command palette on the native <dialog> — scales in, filters as you type with fuzzy matching and highlighted letters, results stagger in and a highligh

- `<usa-cube>` (motionary/components/depth): Up to six children become the faces of a CSS 3D cube. Drag / swipe, arrow keys, autoplay or show("top"); spring-driven, the front face is the only one exposed t

- `<usa-segmented>` (motionary/components/widgets): 6.7: an iOS-style thumb slides under the chosen segment with a spring and stretches while it travels. A real radio group: arrow keys, Home / End. iOS, pill or o

- `<usa-shimmer-text>` (motionary/components/text): A light sweep across gradient-filled text. CSS only; colours and speed via attributes or custom properties.

- `<usa-skeleton>` (motionary/components/feedback): Shimmering placeholders while loading; remove loading and the real content fades in. aria-busy included.

- `<usa-sketch-chart>` (motionary/components/widgets): 8.5: a hand-drawn chart — wobbly pencil axes with hatched bars or a sketchy line, sketched in stroke by stroke when it scrolls into view.

- `<usa-spinner>` (motionary/components/feedback): Six indeterminate indicators: the WinUI progress ring, the Windows 10 orbiting dots, ring, typing dots, pulse and bars.
- `<usa-splash>` (motionary/components/page): An app launch screen that leaves (fade, scale, slide-up, circle) once the page has loaded — never sooner than min ms.
- `<usa-split-text>` (motionary/components/text): Splits a headline into letters or words and cascades them in: rise, fade, blur, flip or pop. Words never break.
- `<usa-spotlight>` (motionary/components/interaction): The Windows Fluent “Reveal” effect: a light follows the pointer, lighting the borders of nearby items and the hovered one.
- `<usa-spring>` (motionary/components/physics): bounce-in, pop and drop entrances with true spring timing (CSS linear() easing), plus jelly and rubber-band attention effects on view, hover or click.
- `<usa-stagger>` (motionary/components/reveal): Reveals direct children one after another — lists, grids, feature rows.

- `<usa-stepper>` (motionary/components/widgets): 6.7: the rail fills toward the current step, finished steps pop a drawn check mark and the current step pulses. Horizontal or vertical; next() / prev() / value.
